text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Penggalakan Pelaburan
(Aktiviti Digalakkan dan Keluaran Digalakkan) 2012.
(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 2 Mac 2012.
Aktiviti digalakkan dan keluaran digalakkan

2. Aktiviti dan keluaran yang disenaraikan dalam Jadual Pertama ditentukan
sebagai aktiviti digalakkan dan keluaran digalakkan.
Pembatalan

3. Perintah yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual Kedua dibatalkan.

PROMOTION OF INVESTMENTS ACT 1986
PROMOTION OF INVESTMENTS (PROMOTED ACTIVITIES AND PROMOTED PRODUCTS)
ORDER 2012
IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 4 of the Promotion of Investments Act
1986 [Act 327], the Minister, with the concurrence of the Minister of Finance, makes the
following order:
Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Promotion of Investments (Promoted
Activities and Promoted Products) Order 2012.
(2) This Order comes into operation on 2 March 2012.
Promoted activities and promoted products
2. The activities and products listed in the First Schedule are determined to be
promoted activities and promoted products.
Revocation
3. The Orders as set out in the Second Schedule are revoked.
